scope: A fixed-seed paired system CAL24 preventive-maintenance PMReplacement experiment: a scheduled one-LRU exchange with PMRF=1 versus PMRF=0.5, using four calendar opportunities over 120 hours, local stock and removed-item overhaul.

report_settings.method: Rebuild accepted J08-format ItemPositionSettings selector from pinned installed Default.sxs and independently select BASE-01.

manual.rule: PMReplacement demand is sent at PM-task start; removed subitems leave after REMOVE and replacement waits until all are present. SCHED=Y sends removed item to PMLocation overhaul. PMRF=1 is deterministic; PMRF<1 is a random per-item draw. PMFailureMode is a separate later variant and is not inferred here.

frozen_source_delta: Use accepted D14.var01 monitored geometry: one aircraft, one installed LRU, one local stocked spare, one base and the accepted three missions. Retain explicit item structure and local PMLocation for the removed LRU.

Convert the item OPHOURS PM into system CALHOURS PM SYS-CAL24 with a 24-hour interval, same system PMLocation PMT0.5 and item overhaul PMLocation PMT1.0. PMReplacement is SCHED=Y, PMRQ1 and no OPID. Extend Control and ResultCollection to h120, track the item, and add half-hour ITEM collection.

Only ProblemDescription and PMReplacement.PMRF differ between certain and fractional arms (1.0 versus 0.5). Seed1, all missions, opening stock, operation parameters and repair/transport structure are identical.
acceptance_hypotheses: Both sources import/export with exact populated-cell roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, usable SXO/event/default-report outputs and a station-selected ItemResults report from each sealed SXO.

System CAL24 PM opportunities are visible in both arms; each physically performed scheduled replacement sends item demand at PM task start, removes an installed physical LRU, fits a distinct stocked or overhauled LRU, and sends the removed LRU to the local item PM action. Physical IDs and stock reconcile without duplication.

Certain arm performs an exchange at every observed PM opportunity. Fractional arm has at least one observed exchange and one observed no-exchange opportunity under fixed seed1; otherwise this candidate is retained as a diagnostic and a new frozen version/seed panel is needed.
Selected station item-stock rows and aggregate system PM occupancy align with events through h120; mission outcomes and terminal state are documented, not inferred from PMRF alone.
gate: Publish only if all native and selected-report seals/roundtrips pass, the four observed PM opportunities contain the specified deterministic and mixed fractional pattern, event-level item demand/removal/fit/overhaul and stock ledger reconcile, and independent read-only replay agrees. If converter or native behavior contradicts the frozen hypotheses, keep an immutable diagnostic and revise a new version.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One seed, one system, one LRU position, one local spare and four calendar opportunities; no general PMRF probability estimate, multiple quantities, SCHED=N, PMFailureMode, GUI or cross-engine claim.
